summary: The range itself is sound, but one carried QA row is carried on reachability reasoning alone and I reject that carry.

blockers.area: QA carry: s1 happy path (widget,19.99 + gadget,5.01 -> 25.00; f1/s1-happy.md)
blockers.defect: The row is carried because its total is under 1000.00 and groupThousands is not reached. The delta rewrites src/format.ts, the module every printed total goes through, and s1's output is produced by formatCents in that same file; the carry rests on reading the guard, not on an observation of the changed tree, and the artifact predates this range.
blockers.evidence: src/format.ts in the patch: groupThousands is replaced in the file that holds formatCents and its `whole >= 1000` guard; the s1 artifact was captured before this range.
blockers.change: Re-run s1 on the head of this range before the next wave and cite the new capture; the other carries stand.
